notes.title: More scoreboards
notes.content: Added the option to view scores around your own and only view scores from friends. This makes it possible to see your own score in the leaderboard even if you're not top 10.

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
Added 7 achievements (more will probably be added later):
[olist]
5 combo
10 combo
20 combo
Beat the developer's highscore
Kill an enemy with the box
Kill an enemy with another enemy
Fail to start the game
[/olist]

notes.title: Steamworks implementation and global leaderboards
notes.content: Added global leaderboard using steamworks and more sleek setting sfor what's displayed on the leaderboard.
